item.title: 2026 property tax reduction application period is open
item.description: Washington County residents who may qualify for Idaho’s Property Tax Reduction Program, commonly known as the “circuit breaker,” are encouraged to begin the application process well ahead of the April 15 deadline. The program is designed to help reduce property taxes for qualifying homeowners by applying a state-funded reduction to their property tax bill.
